_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the ArchiSteamFarm egg in pelican-eggs/software (MIT).
name: ArchiSteamFarm
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: ArchiSteamFarm idles Steam trading cards on any number of accounts at once. Its web interface is on the server's port, where you add bots and enter Steam Guard codes.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ArchiSteamFarm: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub
# and checks its checksum. Your bots and settings (config), plugins and logs
# are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac
put_release() {
    local new=$1 e; shift
    local keep=" $* "
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        while IFS= read -r e; do
            if [ -n "$e" ] && [ ! -e "$new/$e" ] && [ "${keep#* "$e" }" = "$keep" ]; then rm -rf -- "./$e"; fi
        done < .raptor-files
    fi
    : > .raptor-files.new
    while IFS= read -r e; do
        if [ "${keep#* "$e" }" != "$keep" ] && [ -e "./$e" ]; then
            if [ -d "$new/$e" ]; then cp -rn "$new/$e/." "./$e/" || true; fi
        else
            rm -rf -- "./$e"
            mv "$new/$e" "./$e"
        fi
        echo "$e" >> .raptor-files.new
    done < <(find "$new" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f\n')
    mv -f .raptor-files.new .raptor-files
    rm -rf "$new"
}

want="${ASF_VERSION:-latest}"
version=$(gh-release tag JustArchiNET/ArchiSteamFarm "$want") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 6.3.11.7, then reinstall."

if [ -f ArchiSteamFarm.dll ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "ArchiSteamFarm $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading ArchiSteamFarm $version"
    gh-release download JustArchiNET/ArchiSteamFarm "$version" ASF-generic.zip $work/asf.zip
    gh-release download JustArchiNET/ArchiSteamFarm "$version" SHA512SUMS $work/asf.sums
    grep -q "^$(sha512sum $work/asf.zip | cut -d' ' -f1)  ASF-generic.zip$" $work/asf.sums || { rm -f $work/asf.zip; fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    unzip -q $work/asf.zip -d .raptor-new
    rm -f $work/asf.zip .raptor-new/*.cmd .raptor-new/*.ico .raptor-new/*.desktop .raptor-new/*.service .raptor-new/ArchiSteamFarm-Service.sh
    put_release .raptor-new config plugins logs
    echo "$version" > .raptor-version
fi

mkdir -p config
# Headless (bots are run from the web interface), and updated by
# reinstalling rather than by itself.
[ -f config/ASF.json ] || echo '{"Headless": true, "IPC": true, "UpdatePeriod": 0}' | jq . > config/ASF.json
[ -f config/IPC.config ] || echo '{"Kestrel": {"Endpoints": {"HTTP": {"Url": "http://*:1242"}}}}' | jq . > config/IPC.config
echo "Installed ArchiSteamFarm $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The ArchiSteamFarm version to install, such as 6.3.11.7, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Web interface password
variables.description: The password for the web interface. It can't be opened from outside the server without one.
